clips.title: The story
paras: Hildelve's Journal was recovered from the dwarf's remains in Dun Morogh. Its bloodstained pages recount a fatal meeting with a fierce bear and his last wish for vengeance.

Dwarven pilot Hildelve set out alone into Dun Morogh after his steam tank broke down. He left his partner, Hammerfoot, with the tanks and went searching the snow-swept crags for rumored chiron ore. His journal says Mangeclaw, a monstrous ice claw bear, stalked him for days before ambushing him. Hildelve fought bravely and drove the bear off, but the beast mauled him, leaving him gravely wounded and stranded in the cold. His final hours were agonizing. Before the predator returned to finish him, Hildelve left one clear plea: whoever found his body should hunt Mangeclaw and avenge his death.
